original_test_intent: Preserve complete E1S_BD3 I2C-related coverage as the only BD3 row, without guessing whether it requires logical BMC access, physical connector/continuity validation or both.

manual_activity: E1.S/platform owners must define the only BD3 case's complete logical and/or physical coverage so no management-path or connector failure mode is silently omitted.
required_inputs: BD3 board, slot, cable and connector identity
Pinout, isolation/ESD, instruments and measurement limits if physical
safety_requirements: Do not copy BD1 or BD2 steps
Do not assume physical continuity is the entire BD3 case
Do not probe unknown pins or bus addresses
Do not energize incomplete or miswired hardware
Do not treat one evidence modality as proof of the other
Stop on damage, open/short, storage, management or bus anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Perform no bus access or physical work
engineer_actions: Define BD3 identity and full coverage stages
Approve logical route and/or physical measurement method
Set evidence and acceptance for each stage

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master is incomplete but not contradictory, and no second BD3 row creates a cross-row conflict. The blocker is the absent operation and criterion.

blocked_analysis.analysis: As the only BD3 row, its undefined operation prevents determining both safe execution and whether all intended coverage is preserved. Selecting MANUAL ONLY or a logical probe would each risk an unrecorded gap.

engineering_decision_request.question: Define Functionality row 1813 Wistron-HW-00434-V002 E1S_BD3, the only BD3 source row: exact board/slot/cable/connector identity and whether complete coverage requires BMC/OOB logical I2C reachability, physical inspection/continuity, or both; provide route/responses and/or pinout/isolation/measurement limits, storage-health criteria, aborts and recovery while preserving Master and requiring fresh review.

review_improvement: Recognizes that no companion logical BD3 row exists and prevents a physical-only assumption from silently reducing the sole BD3 coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Unlike BD2, BD3 has no separate I2C-prefixed row in the manifest. Therefore the missing specification is not merely a procedural prerequisite; it determines whether the library's only BD3 requirement covers the management protocol, physical interconnect or both. A safe classification cannot be chosen without that scope decision.
